meta.parties: Croos Raj Chandra v. Commissioner of Inland Revenue

rules.statement: For a business carried on by a charity to be exempt from income tax, there must be a close identification between the carrying on of the business and the carrying out of the primary purpose of the trust.
rules.supporting_quote: "There can be little doubt that had the word 'actual' appeared in this Indian provision the view that the business need not be an integral activity of the trust may well have been modified. For these reasons, the Indian authorities cited have not created any difficulty in the way of the view we have formed, namely, that there should be a close identification between the carrying on of the business and the carrying out of the primary purpose of the trust."
